confidence_notes: Restaurant and coffee anchors combine current Sri Lanka-wide typical prices with Sigiriya meal estimates; visitor-facing venues can cost more than local eateries. Cocktail and wine are bounded estimates based on their price relationship to restaurant beer. Accommodation is a holistic estimate without live listings.
comparable_city_reasoning: Used Sri Lanka-wide typical restaurant prices, adjusted toward Sigiriya's visitor-oriented market; no close city comparison was needed.
